what_this_is: The cross-domain doors that are OPEN on the line today. Every entry is a violation of the rule
gate:domain-doors enforces (PRD decision 46), pinned to path:line, and every entry names the
ruling that will close it. The list exists so the gate is GREEN on the tip on the day it lands
and RED the moment a NEW undeclared door appears — a gate that starts red is a gate nobody runs.
It is checked in BOTH directions: an entry matching no current violation FAILS the gate too, so
the list cannot rot into a permanent exemption and cannot outlive the code it excuses. Pinning
path:line also means a door that MOVES turns the gate red — deliberately: a moved door is a
re-decision, and it gets looked at.
This list shrinking IS the migration backlog. The only correct direction for it is shorter.
